sentence: This project studies how the brain of the fruit fly chooses between starting social contact and reacting to a partner.
This project tries to find and redesign protein molecules that switch proteases on or off, using nanobodies and deep learning.
This project develops robots that can work on their own in harsh places, including underwater and in space.
This project studies how the math behind a problem can guide the design of deep neural networks that solve inverse problems.
This project builds ways to describe how energy moves through physical systems that are far from equilibrium.
This project studies how common methods for solving large optimization problems can make use of smooth structure in the problem.
This project studies how the shape of the data can help design deep learning systems that are easier to understand.
This project studies how to make devices that use light instead of electricity to sense and process images.
This project studies how rules for sending data between computers can stay safe when some parts run in protected hardware in the cloud.
This project studies how the shaping of mountains over long times and competition between species affect the variety of lizards and snakes living there.
This project builds a software tool that turns microscopy and spectroscopy data into standardized measurements of materials.
This project builds learning methods that let many machines make decisions together without seeing all the information.
This project studies how clustering of tiny iron oxide particles changes their magnetic properties.
This project builds a web tool that combines satellite, airborne and ground data to map forest structure and biomass over time.
This project builds an instrument that makes detailed pictures of molecules in biological tissues.
This project sets up a mass spectrometer that shows where drugs, toxins, lipids and other molecules sit inside tissues and cells.
This project studies how separate male and female plants and their sex chromosomes evolved in docks and sorrels.
